definition: The visual association cortex is a temporo-occipital brain region examined for its activity during a visual memory task. In this study, it was treated as part of the brain involved in processing visually related information during memory retrieval.

reasons: The definition claims the region was “treated as part of the brain involved in processing visually related information during memory retrieval,” but the packet only reports that temporo-occipital visual association cortex ROI activity was examined during a visual encoding and retrieval task, without explicitly stating that the study’s framing “treated” it as a component of visually related processing during retrieval.

The packet supports that temporo-occipital visual association cortex activity was examined in a visual encoding/retrieval task, but it does not support the broader functional claim that this region was treated as part of the brain involved in processing visually related information during memory retrieval.
